notes.title: Use a game pad with your Wolf Balls!
notes.content:
Update version 1.2 now offers near complete controller support (a keyboard is only needed when entering a high score)!

other update notes: fixed a scoring issue scores going below true zero

Thank you community for reaching out to me about the gamepad, Wolf Balls should be more enjoyable than ever now!

I am in the process of new levels and events, adding more content all the time.  The MAC OSX version is coming soon.

Thank you for the positive reviews and support!  I will content to update this game with new levels and free content.

notes.title: Welcome to Wolf Balls 1.1 Update!!!
notes.content:
The 1.1 update adds incredible new content!!!

You have to see Mega Sheep, it is hilarious.

Each level now has a boss that can be triggered based on what you do in-game.  Also in the update--assets redesigned, bug fixes, game play tweaks, and improved CPU loads.  See the list:

Introducing Mega Sheep, Moose Fury, and Crowzilla!!
added flippers also to F, 
shortened ball grab distance
increased zone score on ramps
fixed ability to spam score on garden plot and snowman bumpers
improved cpu functions on HUD
customized assets visually
removed decals from board
fixed AI navigation issue on Night Village Level
removed zone scoring from ball launch
reduced damage to sheep/moose from mere physical contact
truncated floating point scores to integers

notes.title: Final Pre Release Update
notes.content:
Added a feature that lets a user choose graphical quality. 
Added a feature that temporarily 'breaks' a bumper so that you can't spam score. 
Improved run animation speed.
Changed volume of SFX.
Sold part of soul to Devil.
Direct infusion of cosmic Game-Mojo-Mana-Juice to enhance player experience.
Had Wolf Balls inspected for fleas.

notes.title: pre release update 1
notes.content:
Did an update to improve clarity about a key feature allowing ball control with R Click.

Improved lighting on Graveyard level and Night Village level.

Fixed area in Graveyard level where ball got stuck.
